name: pdk-tap-surveymonkey-etl
instr:
Our CX team rebuilt the customer surveys with dropdown matrix questions, "Other (please specify)" options, comment boxes and open-ended questions that validate numbers and dates. Since then the warehouse can't use much of what the tap in /app emits. Dropdown, Other and comment answers in response_answers point at ids that question_options never lists, and numbers and dates only exist as typed text. A capture of the API traffic from one full sync is in /data/surveymonkey/.

question_options should list every option a response can point at, Other options and comment boxes included, plus the choices under each dropdown column, which also need a col_id. response_answers needs number_value, the number for answers to questions validated as whole or decimal numbers, and date_value, a YYYY-MM-DD date for questions validated as dates, read in the date format the question asks for. If the text isn't valid in the question's format, or the question is no longer in the survey, keep the row with a null value, as for every other answer. Values follow the survey as it is at sync time. This must also work when response_answers is the only selected stream and on incremental runs, and a sync may request each survey's details at most once more than today. Nothing else in the output should change.

Could you find what's going wrong and fix it? The tests in /app/tests and CI's type checks (mypy and ty) must keep passing. There's no network here.
